tei:titleStmt.tei:title: las gshin phrin las gnam lcags dum bu bzhugs so/ /sku gsung thugs ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba gdul dka' 'dul ba'i pha
las gshin phrin las gnam lcags dum bu bzhugs so/ /sku gsung thugs ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba gdul dka' 'dul ba'i pha

tei:div.tei:p: las gshin phrin las gnam lcags dum bu bzhugs so// sku gsung thugs ldan rdo rje 'chang*// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir// las kyi gshin rje phrin las bstan/ ya bhyoḥ stong pa rten 'byung 'gags pa med// sems can srid pa'i las kyi gshed// nyon mongs gsum gyi ma bsdus med// brgyad khri bzhi stong las nyon rtsal// gshin rje bye ba dgu khri'i grong*// lcags mkhar thod pa'i kha bad can// sgo med mun pa'i steng rim na// 'dod khams khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs// gzugs khams sems can sna tshogs bam// rus myag ma tshang phyed pa'i gzugs// bam ril lhu dum khrol ba'i steng*// gzugs med keng rus phung pos khyab// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brdal ba la// 'jigs pa'i ma he khro gtum rngams// gang la bya ba rmig pas brdzis// nyams pa bdun ldan dgra bo la// zhe sdang 'bar ba'i thugs kyi brnag /rab tu khros pa'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'bud sgra drag pos bla la 'bod// rdo rje'i rwa rtse 'gegs la gzengs// spu rtses dug gi zhun rtsi 'phen// zhing lpags keng rus sga cha la// sbrul dang mi mgo'i rgyan gyis brjid// gshin rje bye ba sa ya'i tshogs// ya las bskyed cing ya la bsdud// ya ma nag mo'i 'phro 'du las// thod dbyug ya mas mtshan par bsam// de las skad cig dran rdzogs su// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag /skye 'gro'i tshe srog bdag po ni// las kyi gshin rje nam mkha'i mdangs// rngams pa'i sku la khros pa'i thugs// dmod pa sngags kyi mtshon cha 'bebs// ral pa khams nag sprin ltar gtib// dbang rtags rdo rje phyed pas mtshan// g.yang gzhi sbrul dang thod pas brgyan// g.yas pas thod dbyug me 'bar bas// zhing bcu tshang ba phye mar gtor// g.yon pas khram shing zhags pa bsnams// nyams pa bdun ldan khram la 'debs// lhu tshigs bzhi las bdud bzhi po// sems can kun la gshed du 'gyed// bu ga dgu nas dug rlung 'tshub// ma lus med pa'i sems can la// sum brgya drug cu'i nad gtong zhing*// ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs yang sprul// yang sprul mon bdud ma mo 'bum// nyams pa re re'i srog la gzab// g.yon du bdud mo gsod byed ma// mthing nag mun pa'i go zu can// ral pa'i zar bu g.yon du 'phyang*// me long g.yas la khram shing g.yon// ma mo'i sde dpon mthu mo che// mche ba zangs yag dgra la gtsigs// bshug pa'i 'thor rlung bgegs la 'bod// nam zla dus bzhi'i gshin rje bzhi// zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dang*// zhag gi gshed po sum cu gnyis// bdun brgya nyi shu la sogs pa'i// gshin rje bye ba sa yas bskor// kun kyang gcer bu shun gos gsol// dug thun khrag zor dgra la 'phen// rbod gtong rngam pa'i tshul du bsam// ya bhyoḥ

phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na// nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na// thodapa lcags kyi grong khyer nas// gshin rje chos rgyal yab yum la// 'khor du las gshin bye bas bskor// sngon tshe 'jam dpal khros pa'i bka'// bar du phyag na rdo rje'i lung*// tha ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshig /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol// khram bdag chen po da tshur byon// gtad len nag po da tshur byon// bla tshe srog bdag da tshur byon// sngags kyi las mkhan da tshur byon// thun gyi pho nya da tshur byon// gshegs byon bzhugs par mi 'tshal te// dngos po tsam gyi chos nyid lags// dur khrod rdzas chen bkram pa la// sgrub pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du// rbod gtong bdag po rten par bzhugs// dgra bgegs bsad pa'i dam tshig 'di// dam tshig chen po bla na med// bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' na// khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig sa ma ya rakṣa na ra ga amṛ ta ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ da la chen po'i lho phyogs su// mā ra bsad pa'i rten bca' ba// rang gshed dug gsum grub pa yi// btson khang gru gsum bang rim ldan// king bdud ma mo'i rtsang gis brgyan// dur khrod ras chen dug khrag byug /dmigs pa'i rten du ling ga bcas// ming rus bla rtags sngags kyis bskor// gser g.yu dung gsum byad thag bcas// bsad pa'i 'ben du khyod la 'bul// dkon mchog spyi dgra cham la phob// bla ma'i sku dgra rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor sgos dgra phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// zag rdzas nya sha bu ram gyis// nya bo dmar po khrag gis byug /mtshan nyid tshang ba dmigs pa'i rta// khyod la brnag pa'i rten du 'bul// dkon mchog spyi dgra cham la phob// bla ma'i sku dgra rdul du rlog rnal 'byor sgos dgra phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// dgra bgegs gnad nas 'gugs pa'i tshe// bla rtags sprul pa drug dang bcas// rang dbang med par 'gug pa'i phyir// lcags spyang 'phar ba dom dred dang*// stag gzig mkha' lding bya nag tshogs// spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// 'go ba'i lha lngas bsrung bas na// khyod ni nye 'byed phra ma mkhan// mthun pa'i lham 'bog zhabs ma dang*// sa bcud sbrul nya rta bon rnams// nag po chen por sbyor ba'i rdzas// 'bul lo dbye ba'i phrin las mdzod// dkon mchog spyi dgra cham la phob// bla ma'i sku dgra rdul du rlog

/rnal 'byor sgos dgra phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ban dgra nag po 'dul ba dang*// sngags pa nang rgyas byed pa na// gshed kyi bdud bzhi bslang ba dang*// zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa dang*// 'dod chags khrag gi sbal bar sprul// sdig pa snying la 'dzing ba dang*// dmar len srog gi 'bru brgyad phyir// don snying nang khrol gcal du spung*// snod drug lcags bzhi lhu ru gtub// drod dbugs 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas// gsol lo mchod do mnyes par mdzod// pho rgyud nyi ma'i gung la rgyu// grib po 'grib zhing bla la rgyug /yungs kar ke tshe shing gi tshe// lcags phye dug dang sbyar bas bskang*// mo rgyud mtshan mo'i gung la 'grim// chu bo'i gzhung la rta ru zhon// nyams pa'i srog la hab sha khyer// yungs nag zangs phye khrag gis brgyan// dza gad phud kyis thugs dam bskang*// mtshon cha sngags kyi ngar gdags pa'i// phur pa ral gri skyer pa'i rtsang*// 'byung ba lnga dang rba rdo'i thun// bsad pa las kyi mtshon cha rnams// gshin rje rgyal po 'khor bcas la// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rdzas su 'bul// dkon mchog spyi dgra cham la phob// bla ma'i sku dgra rdul du rlog rnal 'byor sgos dgra phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// khyad par mthun pa'i dam tshig rdzas// gri snying g.yag gi tsitta dang*// rta nag rab chad snying gi sbug srog gi 'khor lo gtam pas bskang*// las mtha' ar la gtad pa'i phyir// las kyi brub gzhung dgra rdzas dang*// dril chas 'byung lnga'i thag pas brgyan// gsol lo mchod do bzhes su gsol// me khams dmar po'idagra byung na// rang gshed rang la 'bebs pa'i tshe// khyod ni chu lha'i rgyal po byung*// rus mtsho klad pas thugs dam bskang*// sa khams ser po'i dgra byung na// rlung la bskur zhing bcol ba na// khyod ni rig 'dzin gdon gyi bdag

dbugs mtsho glo ba'i thugs dam bskang*// chu khams dkar po'i dgra byung na// 'byung ba dgra gshed sdebs pa na// khyod ni me lha'i rgyal po byung*/ khrag mtsho mchin pas thugs dam bskang*// rlung khas ljang gu'i dgra byung na// mun pa'i go cha bskon pa na// khyod ni sa bdag klu gnyan sprul// sha mtsho mkhal las thugs dam bskang*// dkon mchog spyi dgra cham la phob// bla ma'i sku dgra rdul du rlog rnal 'byor sgos dgra phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// sde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad pa'i tshe// khyod ni du ba mjug ring sprul// nyi shu gnyis kyi nyi myur la// nub nas shar lhor rgyu ba'i tshe// rgyab ri dmag dpung khyed la 'tshol// rnal 'byor nag po'i sems 'chang zhing*// mtshon cha dmigs pa'i rta la bskyon// nyams pa rten dang bral ba yi// sha khrag drod dbugs rtsa rgyus dang*// dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga// go ro tsa na ba su ta// zhing chen zhing chung srog gi rgyun// tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang gis// mchod pa chen po bla na med// las gshin yab yum 'khor dang bcas// thugs dam bskang ngo bzhes su gsol// dkon mchog spyi dgra cham la phob// bla ma'i sku dgra rdul du rlog rnal 'byor sgos dgra phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// las kyi gshin rje'i phrin las ni// bla ma nag thod rdo ris mgos// yang du yang du bskul bas na// brjod don med kyang shugs kyis thal// 'di la rgyud lung man ngag med// lung dang rig pa'i dbang po med// de phyir nyams mtshar gad mo'i gnas// las gshin sgrub kyang ci zhig dgos// snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag cing*// me chu rlung gi 'jig pa kun// las kyi gshin rje'i ngo bo yin// dngos po skad cig skye 'gags can// gnas pa cung zad mi rnyed cing*// las kyi gshin rje'i za ba yin// sems can skye zhing 'chi ba kun// 'di yi ma zos gcig kyang med// skye tsam nyid nas 'di la dbang*// mi rtag nyid kyang gshin rje la// gshin rje nyid kyang mi rtag na// thams cad dus kyis za bar byed// dus kyang za ba'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sems nyid de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings// thams cad zos na mi dga'am// thams cad dus las 'dasapa yi// mnyam pa nyid kyi gzhi klong du// rang grol bde chen dag pa'i sku// kha sbyor bdun ldan thob par shog

/las kyi rdo rjes shar mar spel ba'o// ༈ de nas dum bu gnyis pa ni// gtor ma'i rim pa gsal bar bya// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// rten gtor bsad pa'i sha dang khrag /dur khrod rdzas chen bkram par bya// ya bhyoḥ 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba// gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod na// rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// mdangs gsol srog gi snying po phul// dbang bskur gsang ba'i dam tshig blangs// las kyi bya ba'i gnyer gtad pa// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung mar bskos// rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub par chad// de ring rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyan po ru// zhun chen gsal ba'i mdangs phyung zhing*// bam chen gsang ba'i longs spyod bshams// rkang gling bshug pa'i sgra dang bcas// has sta nag pos g.yab 'dor na// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol// 'bru zan khrag chang dug gi sa bran// rin chen sna lnga'i phab kyis gtams// gru gsum thod pa'i ba gam brjid// gti mug mun pa'i mdangs kyis 'khyud// zhe sdang drag po'i me dpung 'bar// 'dod chags khrag gi zham chu 'babs// logs la nga rgyal mtshon cha gzengs// phrag dog bdud bya sprin ltar gtib// gri snying rus pa rtags kyis mtshan// pho brang chen po'i bcud du bltams// dar nag bla bres skyer ba'i mda'// thog lcags phye ma khrag gis brlan// dpa' bo'i lcags kyi mde'us bskyon// 'bod rbad bsad pa'i sngags dang bcas// le brgan dmar po'i gshog pa brkyang*// rten gtor chen po khyod la 'bul// bzhugs pa'i rten du bzhes su gsol// pho brang rten la gnas pa'i tshe// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// las rnams thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir// dmar gyi gtor ma sha khrag brgyan// sna tshogs sems can mdangs kyis bskor// tsa rog ra so'i mdangs dang ldan// shel snying spyi dkar mkha' lding bya// rgyu mchog chen po rnam pa lnga// ma nyams dpal gyi chang phud bcas// rtag gtor chen po khyed la 'bul// dgra la phrin las ma zhen mdzod// bgegs la nus mthu ma chung zhig

/mchod bstod bsnyen cing bsgrub pa na// dregs pa'i dmag dpung bsdu ba dang*// dmag ngo len zhing dmag dpaun bsko// mthun pa'i dmag zas 'gyed pa'i phyir// gru gsum liṅga ming spel gzhugs// rgyun gtor nar mas thugs dam bskang*// yid la brnag pa'i zhe sdang can// sbyor ba ngan pa'i skye rgyud chod// ban dgra nag po cham la phob// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de nas bstod bskul bya ba ni/ e bhyoḥ ya ma ra tsa gshin rje'i bdag /'jig rten gnas nas sku bzhengs pa// khyod la phyi yi mtshan gsol ba// gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po bya// 'gro ba'i dge sdig rtsis la phabs// skye 'chi gnyis po khrom la 'debs// legs nyes gnyis la shwa rdel 'phen// nyams pa can la chad pa gcod// drang mkhan gnyen po khyod la bstod// 'jam dpal khros pa'i bka' byung tshe// stong gsum ma lus khyab par rgyug /tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon// gnam sa med par sbar mos 'debs// ri klung thams cad rjes kyis bkang*// ri rab thams cad tsog por 'phen// rgya mtsho thams cad skom du 'thung*// snod kyi 'jig rten thal bar rlog /sems can kha mngar med par za// yid la brnag pa'i nyams pa can// gti mug sha la khams tshad 'debs// 'dod chags khrag la hub kyis 'thung*// zhe sdang rkang rus phye mar gtubs// nga rgyal snying la sbar mos thob// phrag dog dbugs la hur thum gyis// 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la// 'du ba rnam bzhis thun phob la// dwangs ma tshe yi rgya mdud khrol// kun gzhi skye ba'i sa bon choms// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// sgrub pa'i gnas nas skur bzhengs pa// khyod la nang gi mtshan gsol ba// dam can srog bdag nag po zhes// rnal 'byor sgrub la bu bzhin brtse// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po skyong*// dam sri 'byung po zas su za// gsang sngags nang gi dam tshig can// gzi ldan 'bar ba mtshams kyi bdag

/ki king rngam pa khyod la bstod// 'jam dpal khros pa'i sogs 'gre'o// 'og min gnas nas skur bzhengs pa/ khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// sems dpa' sngon po sgrol ba'i king*// rang lus rgyal ba'i gdan du phul// gsang ba kun gyi mdzod 'chang zhing*// sems kyi shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyong*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod// 'jam dpal khros pa'i= sangs rgyas mdzad pa sgrub pa'i tshe// rgyal ba'i thugs las skur bzhengs pa// khyod la don gyis mtshan gsol ba// rig pa'i skyes bu chos kyi rgyal// rdul snyed sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis// yang dag lam la 'gro ba 'dren// sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis su med// khyod ni mi sprul gang yang med// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i bka' la sdod// khro gtum can la khros par ston// 'dod chags can la zhi bar snang*// nga rgyal can la brjid par bzhengs// ser sna can la phrog par ston// phrag dog can la gdug par mdzod// sna tshogs rol ston khyed la bstod// 'jam dpal khros pa'i bka' byung tshe// stong gsum ma lus khyab par rgyug /tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon// gnam sa med par sbar mos 'debs// ri klung thams cad rjes kyis bkang*// ri rab thams cad tsog por 'phen// rgya mtsho thams cad skom du 'thung*// snod kyi 'jig rten thal bar rlog /sems can kha mngar med par za// yid la brnag pa'i nyams pa can// gti mug sha la khams tshad 'debs// 'dod chags khrag la hub kyis 'thung*// zhe sdang rkang rus phye mar gtubs// nga rgyal snying la sbar mos thob// phrag dog dbugs la hur thum gyis// 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i thun phob la// dwangs ma tshe yi rgya mdud khrol// kun gzhi skye ba'i sa bon choms// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// a mtshar rtse mo'i yi ge yin// srin bu'i zos pa'i ri mo bzhin// don ldan snyam na snying po med// las kyi rdo rje'i 'chal gtams so//

༈ ya bhyoḥ ya ki rgyal ba zhi khro nas// 'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad du// kun la srog bzhi ye nas gnas// chu la rlan gyis khyab pa bzhin// sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid// rnam dag byang chub sems kyi ngang*// 'od gsal nyid dang 'du 'bral med// 'bru gsum yi ge brgyad la sogs// dwangs ma lnga yi rgyu las byung*// gnas ni snying gi dbus su gnas// dbyibs ni yi ge gzugs su snang*// kha dog ma nges cir yang snang*// steng 'og phyogs bzhi so so ru// gong non gzir dgug spu gri gnas// dbyangs dang gsal byed sde gnyis nas// rang la mthun zhing mi bslu ba// nus pa mngon du 'byin pa yi// rtsa ba dbus su ya ma gnas// 'byin pa'i rlung la me da kṣi// ra dza sa do bdun ser gnas// gnas pa'i rlung la ru ṇa yo// ni ra ya tsa ni 'bru bdun// yab kyi yi ge 'bru bcu bdun// gsang sngags yi ge gzugs su shar// bzlas pas mtshon la ngar gdags bzhin// rlung nyid ye nas sngags yin mod// 'bras bu mngaun gyur thabs kyis 'phags// rngub pa'i rlung gi rang bzhin ni// ma ting trig a hūm̐ dza phaṭaḥ yum gyi yi ge 'bru bdun shar// gzugs sngags sbyar ba nyi shu gcig me 'dra chu 'dra thog dang 'dra// las rnams kun la thogs pa med// rngu mtshan med pa 'dod rgyal ming*// gang gang btags pa der gyur snang*// chos rnams ming gi btags pa tsam// snang tsam nyid nas ma grub cing*// med la snang bas brtags pa byas// yin par snang bas byis pa bslu// re zhing dgos pa rgyun mi chad// 'dis kyang rang gi bya ba byed// las kyi sbyor ba'i mtshon cha rnams// gang dgos las la rang rang sdebs// ting 'dzin gcig gis las kun 'grub// sngags gcig gis kyang las kun 'grub// las kun ting 'dzin sngags gcig gis// 'grub pa rab tu mi shes so// de yi khyad par gang gis na// rtsa ba mtshon cha'i khyad par ro// de phyir man ngag dang ldan par// rab tu 'bad pas bzlas byas na// 'bras bu mi bslu 'di'i khyad chos// sa ma yaḥ
dum bu gnyis kyi bdag nyid can// rnam rtog shar ba bzo ma bcos// tshig la sdeb sbyor ma byas par// rang dgar yin pas dgag pa med// las kyi rdo rjes bris pa dge'o/// /
